spells.name: Field-bloom
spells.text: to make the flowers in a dead field open for one afternoon

spells.name: The Long Grass
spells.text: to find a ring dropped in long grass

spells.name: The Cold Cup
spells.text: to keep a cup of tea from ever going cold

spells.name: Widow's Mercy
spells.text: to take a wine stain out of cloth

spells.name: The Quiet Hinge
spells.text: to make a door stop creaking

spells.name: Thin Wall
spells.text: to hear what is being said in the next room, badly

spells.name: Second Day Bread
spells.text: to keep bread from going stale quite so fast

spells.name: Tomorrow's Weather
spells.text: to tell whether it will rain, no better than a farmer can

spells.name: Blue Candle
spells.text: to make a candle burn blue

spells.name: The Straight Nail
spells.text: to straighten a bent nail

spells.name: Horsefly
spells.text: to keep the flies off a horse

spells.name: Summer Ice
spells.text: to freeze over a puddle in high summer

spells.name: One Bird
spells.text: to call a single bird, and only that bird

spells.name: Dry Ink
spells.text: to dry ink the instant it is written

spells.name: The Older Road
spells.text: to tell which of two roads was walked more recently

spells.name: Called Coin
spells.text: to make a coin land the way you called it, one time in three

spells.name: The Still Sleeper
spells.text: to stop a sleeping person snoring

spells.name: Patient Knot
spells.text: to make a rope untie itself, eventually

spells.name: Indoor Snow
spells.text: to make snow fall inside a room, briefly

spells.name: Late Recall
spells.text: to remember where you put a thing, about an hour too late

spells.name: The Even Pour
spells.text: to split a drink into two exactly equal cups

spells.name: Bootless
spells.text: to walk a muddy road without dirtying your boots, if you go slowly

spells.name: The Kept Smell
spells.text: to hold the smell of a room after the room is gone

spells.name: Grandmother's Trick
spells.text: to make a child stop crying, for as long as it amuses them

notes: It works. Nobody has ever needed it to.
The effect lasts about as long as it takes to explain.
It fails if anyone is watching who does not believe in it.
It cost somebody their whole life to write down.
It is the only thing its author is remembered for.
It takes longer to cast than the job takes by hand.
There is a note in the margin: do not bother.
It has no use in a fight, which is rather the point of it.
It is beautiful and it is useless, and those are different things.
Whoever copied it drew a small flower beside it.
It only ever works on the second attempt.
It smells faintly of a house nobody lives in any more.
Three people have died carrying this. None of them for this.
The last hand to write it out was shaking.
found: You write it down. The Codex is one small, useless entry longer.
Nobody will ever need this. You copy it out anyway.
It goes in the book with the others.
A thing worth knowing, for no reason you could defend.
